challenge.better_approach: Publishing isolation as a tester tool was looked at; the orchestrator ruled it a design change and out. Reading the env marker is one line and the predicate itself is exactly that env read (isolation.py:116-118).
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the marker name CAIRN_TESTER_INSTANCE_SEALED is the tester's public contract for a sealed run (it is the env a sealed child sees); if the tester renames it, this proof's guard reads unsealed and refuses loudly, never passes silently.
challenge.prior_art: inside_an_instance_seal (cairn/devices/tester/isolation.py:116) is os.environ.get(INSTANCE_SEAL_MARKER) == '1'; the proof already reads CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID from the environment the same way.
challenge.real_collision: none: dda0e72b9c67's three outcomes stand unchanged; RULE 1 is what this restores.

answers.falsifier: Done when encapsulation_breaches over the live repo names no row whose file is the bin proof, the proof's three dda0 teeth stay green under the seal, and 78a600419a21's PROVED clearance no longer reds on bin. Wrong intent if the tester means isolation to be a published tool (then the import is legal and the charter is the change).
answers.from_idea: none, because it was measured on ticket 78a600419a21 at its PROVED clearance: encapsulation_holds red at bin/proofs/test_a_proof_run_by_any_spelling_is_sealed.py line 81
answers.how: In bin/proofs/test_a_proof_run_by_any_spelling_is_sealed.py, _require_the_seal reads os.environ CAIRN_TESTER_INSTANCE_SEALED == '1' (the marker the tester's sealed run sets) in place of the import; a red-first tooth, declared under this ticket's PROVES, asserts build_inspector's encapsulation_breaches names no row for this file.
answers.traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation: nothing outside a device reaches into its code); Law 9: a deterministic red is fixed, not explained away.
answers.what: dda0's sealed-run proof in bin reads the tester's instance-seal marker from the environment instead of importing cairn.devices.tester.isolation, so component bin stops breaching RULE 1 and every ticket whose clearance reads bin can cross.

bullets.text: dda0's PROVEME and PROVED clearances passed with this import standing (it landed at c9d4e79f6, hours before); 78a6's clearance over the same bin red on it. Why dda0's passed is not cheaply visible: the certificates do not carry the component gate's sieve results.
